additional_labels.along_path_progress_0_2s_m: higher is better, primary Path horizon
additional_labels.censored: mask only; never convert to negative
additional_labels.contact: maximum_contact_n is diagnostic, no universal monotonic quality direction
additional_labels.final_critic: higher is better only within fixed checkpoint, contextualized by initial value
additional_labels.initial_critic: calibration covariate, no monotonic quality direction
additional_labels.raw_joint_effort: maximum_raw_joint_effort is diagnostic and saturated at 3000 in these runs
additional_labels.reach_within_0_2s_0_2m: encounter event, true preferred over false
additional_labels.recovery: diagnostic; larger recovery can follow worse drawdown
additional_labels.termination: cause-specific; never infer failure from timeout

missing_policy: NA, no zero imputation; censored and infrastructure-invalid excluded from teacher
stack_and_termination: all live records negative, insufficient positive support
